answers.reason: As a member of the central university leadership, the vice president for studies is permitted to participate in central bodies like the senate.
Because funding and study programmes are treated as parts of one university-wide plan, the vice president for studies is involved in the central budget planning round.
The vice president holds a higher office and may take part in bodies below their level, especially since appointments are part of the interconnected university-wide plan.
Those with a higher office may take part in bodies below their level, and the faculty council directly handles study regulations.
The vice president holds a higher office than the faculty level and is directly responsible for degree programmes and teaching quality.
The vice president is responsible for examinations across the university and holds a higher office permitting participation in lower-level bodies.
Because holders of a higher office may take part in the bodies below their level, the vice president is permitted to attend this faculty-level round.
The vice president holds a higher office and is responsible for degree programmes, permitting participation in lower-level working groups on modules.
As a holder of a higher office responsible for teaching quality, the vice president may take part in lower-level decisions regarding teaching laboratories.
Holders of a higher office are permitted to take part in all bodies and planning rounds below their level, including those for new students.
